invariants.description: volume conservation: q_C + q_C_d = (v_in - v_out) t exactly
total volume q = q_0 + stressed volume(s)
invariants.expr: np.allclose(q, q_0 + q_C + q_C_d, rtol=1e-9, atol=1e-30)

bc_sweep.rationale: BCs span the reference pressure u_0 up to u_0 + 3 dp (dp = test pressure drop of the vessel class) and flows 0 to 3x the equilibrium flow dp/R; u_ext -1000..1000 Pa (tissue pressure); geometry, E, mu and the wall-thickness coefficients at 0.5-2x (the exact solution is re-evaluated at every point, so all invariants must hold across the whole region).

baseline.reason: candidate: Williams1988 human nailfold capillary pressures (arteriolar limb 37.7, apex 19.4, venular limb 14.6 mmHg, steady mean values): a pp/vp capillary between fixed arteriolar- and venular-limb pressures should give the apex pressure; not set up because a single steady value only checks (u_in + u_out)/2 and needs the owner to agree it is a meaningful baseline
